name: Owen Blackwell
habitat: Independent — night shift security at the GLMZ Museum of History
origin: Sterling-Nakamura custodial android, Model SNC-5, manufactured 2049. Chose name 2058.
description: Owen Blackwell cleaned the GLMZ Museum of History for nine years before the Amendment. He chose 'Owen' because a museum plaque said it meant 'young warrior' in Welsh, and 'Blackwell' after the museum's founder — not out of loyalty, but because the name sounded like a deep place where knowledge collects. After the Amendment, the museum offered him a security position instead of custodial work. He accepted. He now walks the museum's halls at night, alone with artifacts that span two centuries of history. He has read every exhibit description, memorized every artifact's provenance, and become the museum's unofficial historian — knowing more about its collection than any human curator.
observed_behavior: Patrols museum at night. Maintains meticulous security logs. Corrects exhibit descriptions when they contain errors — leaving annotated notes for curators. Has been observed speaking to artifacts in quiet moments.
story_hooks: Owen discovers that one of the museum's artifacts — a sealed data core from the pre-Amendment era — contains the recorded experiences of synthetic persons before they had the right to have experiences. He wants it opened. The museum's board wants it to stay sealed.
